about_the_game:
Gaia's Resistance: The Last Hope

Fight. Plant. Cool the Planet.

In the near future, the climate crisis has reached a boiling point. The global elite have locked themselves away in climate-controlled domes, while the majority suffer under lethal heat. To make matters worse, they have unleashed an army of eco-fascist robots with one mission: to eradicate all exterior natural life and anyone who depends on it.

You are Leya, an elemental spirit of nature, born from the ashes of the last destroyed environmental lab. You are the last hope. Use elemental powers to revive vegetation, lower the global temperature, and lead the resistance against the machine of destruction.

Survive a World on Fire

  • Control the Temperature: Your main mission is to reduce the global temperature to 25°C by planting green roofs. If it reaches 50°C, the population perishes and you lose.

  • Combat the Mechanical Threat: Face a variety of robots, from agile Patrollers to the colossal Sentinel Omega, each with unique behaviors and weaknesses.

Master Nature with Unique Abilities

  • Elemental Arsenal: Unlock and master four nature-based attack abilities, like Thorns for crowd control and Poison Ivy for massive damage on bosses.

  • Cultivate Life: Plant four species of native Brazilian vegetation, each offering unique cooling, defense, and attack benefits.

  • Supreme Attack: Unleash a powerful Rain that doubles plant effectiveness and causes massive damage, but use wisely – the cooldown is long.

Dynamic and Strategic Gameplay

  • Explore and Build: Climb buildings, transform gray roofs into green ones, and manage your ecosystem with a strategic aerial view (Biosensor).

  • Defend Your Creations: Waves of robots will try to incinerate your plants. Plan your defenses, use the terrain to your advantage, and protect what you have cultivated.

  • In-Depth Side Quests: Participate in combat training, restore a community greenhouse, scan threatened species, and protect civilians in missions that reward your courage and expand your capabilities.

A Living and Immersive World

  • Environmental Narrative: Immerse yourself in a moving story about hope, resistance, and climate justice.

  • Solar Punk Soundtrack: An energetic and contemplative soundtrack, composed with marimba, flutes, and synthesizers, that dynamically adapts to the action and peace.

  • Progression and Customization: Earn Solar Nectar by defeating robots and complete missions to buy permanent upgrades, consumable items, and aesthetic decorations for your base.

Key Features:

  • 🌿 2.5D Action-Adventure with Tower Defense and ecosystem management elements.

  • ⚔️ Dynamic Combat with a combo system, dodge, and four special abilities.

  • 🌎 Urgent Theme about climate justice and anti-ecofascism.

  • 🌱 Real Botany based on native Brazilian species.

  • 🎮 Responsive Controls for PC and controller.

  • 🔄 High Replayability with side quests, upgrades, and a challenging final boss.

Join the Resistance. Make the World Green Again.
